item.title: [Due in 4 days] SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android stop reaching SharePoint Server on 27 November 2026 and support SharePoint Online only
item.description:
Users who lose app access to on-premises SharePoint tend to fall back to the mobile browser or unmanaged apps, which may sit outside the app-protection policies that covered the SharePoint app.

item.description:
We are updating the OneDrive sync app for Windows and Mac to exclude new folders named node_modules from syncing by default , beginning December 14, 2026.

Next: 14 Dec 2026.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief

item.title: [New] OneDrive sync stops syncing new node_modules folders by default from 14 December; admins can turn the exclusion off by policy
item.description:
Data that never reaches OneDrive is not covered by Purview retention, DLP or backup that relies on OneDrive; an expected DLP or eDiscovery hit in a synced developer folder will stop appearing.

SharePoint · Tell developer teams before 14 December; decide whether the policy that disables the exclusion is needed for any compliance scope.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] OneDrive moves its addresses to onedrive.cloud.microsoft (September 2026 to September 2027); Microsoft revised the post on 17 November
item.description:
Proxy allow-lists, URL-based detections and SIEM parsers that match '-my.sharepoint.com' will miss OneDrive traffic on the new domain.

SharePoint · Add onedrive.cloud.microsoft to proxy/firewall allow-lists and to any KQL or DLP rule that keys on the OneDrive host name.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1558041 Microsoft OneDrive for iPad: Presentation mode for PDFs
item.description:
Microsoft OneDrive for iPad will introduce a presentation mode for PDFs, enabling a focused, view-only experience that disables free scrolling to prevent accidental page changes. Rolling out worldwide in December 2026, it is enabled by default with no admin controls required and does not affect file permissions or compliance.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1558030 Microsoft OneDrive for Windows and Mac: node_modules folders will be excluded from sync by default
item.description:
Starting December 14, 2026, OneDrive for Windows and Mac will exclude new folders named "node_modules" from syncing by default to improve performance. Existing synced folders remain unaffected. Administrators can disable this exclusion via policy if needed. No user prompts will occur, and local folder use continues.

item.title: [New] MSRC adds two SharePoint CVEs fixed by the November updates but left out of the release: CVE-2026-124223 (RCE) and CVE-2026-124222 (EoP)
item.description:
A SharePoint Server farm that skipped the November cumulative update now carries a named RCE; vulnerability scanners will start flagging it.

SharePoint · Confirm every SharePoint Server farm runs the November 2026 security update and close the two CVEs in the vulnerability tracker.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] SharePoint data access governance reports show files flagged by sensitive information types, and site access reviews can go to site owners or admins
item.description:
Over-shared sites holding credit card or ID numbers are the data an attacker with a guest or compromised account reads first; the report now ranks them.

SharePoint · After rollout run the Site permissions report, sort by sensitive-file count and send access reviews for the top sites with Everyone or anyone links.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] SharePoint search stops refreshing SiteLogoUrl on individual items when a site logo changes (December to March)
item.description:
No security effect; listed because Microsoft marks it a major change and custom search solutions that read the property may show stale logos.

SharePoint · Only if a custom search solution reads SiteLogoUrl from items: read the logo from the site instead.

item.description:
Microsoft SharePoint will enhance data access governance reports and site access reviews starting late November 2026, giving admins better control to identify data risks, prioritize sites, direct review requests, and track email delivery. No action is required before rollout, but admins should prepare accordingly.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1556092 Changes to site logo URL metadata in SharePoint search results
item.description:
SharePoint will change how site logo URLs are updated in search metadata, stopping automatic updates of the SiteLogoUrl property on individual items. Rollout is from December 2026 to March 2027. Organizations using this property in search results should retrieve logos directly from the site instead.
